# HelpGuide.org

> > A nonprofit mental health and wellness resource providing evidence-based guides, coping strategies, and support for mental health conditions and recovery.

HelpGuide.org is a trusted mental health information resource founded by therapist Jeanne Segal, Ph.D., and advised by Harvard Medical School experts. The organization provides comprehensive guides on mental health conditions, wellness strategies, and support resources, with content available in multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health Conditions
- Mental Wellness
- Coping Strategies
- Recovery & Treatment
- Anxiety Disorders
- Depression
- ADHD
- Bipolar Disorder
- Addiction Recovery
- Meditation & Mindfulness
- Mental Health Resources
- Nonprofit Health Information
- Harvard Medical School
- Crisis Support Hotlines
- Evidence-Based Guidance

## Mental Health Conditions & Guides

- [Mental Health - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health): Mental health conditions directory: guides, treatments, coping
- [Depression - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health/depression): Depression guide: symptoms, treatment options, and recovery
- [Anxiety - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health/anxiety): Anxiety disorders guide: symptoms, treatment, and self-help
- [ADHD - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health/adhd): ADHD guide: symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and coping strategies
- [Bipolar Disorder - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health/bipolar-disorder): Bipolar disorder guide: diagnosis, treatment, and coping skills
- [Addiction - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health/addiction): Addiction recovery guide: treatment, coping, and support resources

## Wellness & Support Resources

- [Meditation - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/mental-health/meditation): Guided meditation and mindfulness techniques for stress relief
- [Mental Health Helplines: International Directory](https://www.helpguide.org/find-help): International mental health crisis hotlines and support directory
- [Harvard Health - HelpGuide.org](https://www.helpguide.org/harvard): Harvard Medical School & Health Publishing expert content hub
